request expected parent and lifecycle-ledger identities exactly match

replace only bound_parent_state_version and bound_parent_state_digest with exact post-parent identity
append one compatibility rebind receipt and one idempotency request index entry
validate the resulting lifecycle ledger against the exact post parent through the qualified compatibility adapter

does not change Lifecycle v1 transition policy or add transition types

does not create document bytes or provider authority
does not authorize publication or delivery
